title: Watermark and redaction profiles for Data at Rest Scanning DLP

prose.label: Watermark profile fields.
prose.text: {{watermark-fields}} {{watermark-page}} The file types watermarking supports are open {{gap:watermark-file-types}}.

prose.label: Which rule applies a profile.
prose.text: Which rule action applies a watermark or redaction profile is open {{gap:applying-action}}. The rule's versioning choice for watermarked files is in [[zia.casb.dlp-rules]], and restoring a redacted version is in [[zia.casb.quarantine]].

watermark-what.statement: Watermark profiles are used in SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP: when sensitive content triggers a rule, the service uses the watermark profile associated with the rule to superimpose text diagonally across pages and images, and a profile can also include headers and footers. The profiles add watermark content to multiple file types.

quotes: When sensitive content triggers a SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule, the Zscaler service uses the watermark profile associated with the policy rule to superimpose text diagonally across pages and images to clearly identify the content you want to protect.
Additionally, you can include headers and footers as part of your watermark profiles.
When configuring SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP policy rules, you can use the watermark profiles you create to add watermark content to multiple file types.

watermark-fields.statement: A watermark profile has a Profile Name of up to 128 characters, optional Header Text and Footer Text of up to 50 characters each, and Watermark Text of up to 15 characters; the font style (color, size, style) is applied automatically and cannot be configured.

quotes: Profile Name: Enter a name of up to 128 characters for the watermark profile.
Header Text (Optional): Enter up to 50 characters for the watermark header.
Footer Text (Optional): Enter up to 50 characters for the watermark footer.
Watermark Text: Enter up to 15 characters for the watermark itself.
The font style (i.e., color, size, style) is applied automatically and can't be configured.

watermark-page.statement: The Watermarking page lists each profile's Profile Name and Watermark Text, both sortable, with actions to edit or delete a watermark profile.

quotes: Profile Name: The name of the watermark profile. You can sort this column.
Watermark Text: The text used in the watermark profile. You can sort this column.
Actions: Actions to edit or delete a watermark profile.

redaction-what.statement: Redaction profiles are used in SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP to hide sensitive content: when content triggers a rule, the service uses the redaction profile associated with the rule to replace the content to protect with asterisk (*) or hash (#) characters.

quotes: When sensitive content triggers a SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule, the Zscaler service uses the redaction profile associated with the policy rule to replace the content you want to protect with asterisk (*) or hash (#) characters.

redaction-fields.statement: A redaction profile has a Profile Name of up to 128 characters and a Redaction Type of Use Asterisks to Redact or Use Hash Signs to Redact; the Redaction page lists the Redaction Type (asterisks or hash signs) as a sortable column.

quotes: Profile Name: Enter a name of up to 128 characters for the redaction profile.
Redaction Type: Select either the Use Asterisks to Redact or Use Hash Signs to Redact option to redact sensitive data with asterisk characters (*) or hash characters (#), respectively.
Redaction Type: The type of redaction used (asterisks or hash signs). You can sort this column.

redaction-file-types.statement: Redaction profiles support Archive (.tar, .zip), Comma-Separated Value (.csv), Microsoft Excel (.xls, .xlsm, .xltm, .xlsx, .xltx), Microsoft PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptm, .ppsm, .potm, .pptx, .ppsx, .potx), Microsoft Word (.doc, .docm, .dotm, .docx, .dotx), PDF (editable and read-only files), Plain Text (.txt) and Rich Text (.rtf) files.

quotes: Archive (.tar, .zip)
Comma-Separated Value (.csv)
Microsoft Excel (.xls, .xlsm, .xltm, .xlsx, .xltx)
Microsoft PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptm, .ppsm, .potm, .pptx, .ppsx, .potx)
Microsoft Word (.doc, .docm, .dotm, .docx, .dotx)
PDF (.pdf): Editable and read-only files
Plain Text (.txt)
Rich Text (.rtf)

watermark-file-types.title: Which file types watermarking supports
watermark-file-types.detail: The Watermarking pages say watermark profiles add watermark content to multiple file types without listing them, unlike the redaction profile page, which lists its file types.

applying-action.title: Which rule action applies a watermark or redaction profile
applying-action.detail: Neither the watermark nor the redaction profile pages say which Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule action applies a profile. The Supported DLP Actions table on the About Data at Rest Scanning DLP page lists no watermark, redaction or After Expiry action, although the rule subject records watermark versioning.
